name: overlays/context-menu
title: Context menu
description: Right-click and keyboard menus with submenus.

keyboard.action: With the area focused, open the menu.
Close the submenu and return to its item.
Activate the item, or open its submenu.

notes: The target area is a focusable, labelled `group`, described by a hidden hint that names the keyboard shortcut.
The menu follows the WAI-ARIA menu pattern; items with submenus expose `aria-haspopup="menu"` and `aria-expanded`.
Choosing an item, or pressing Escape, returns focus to the target area.
Escape and ArrowLeft close one level at a time, so you never lose your place.
accessibility.reducedMotion: Menus appear without their short drop.
